properties.description: Detects account manipulation including privilege escalation, group modification, and attribute changes
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4728, 4729, 4730, 4731, 4732, 4733, 4734, 4735, 4737, 4738, 4740, 4741, 4742, 4743, 4754, 4755, 4756, 4757, 4758, 4764) | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), EventID, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName | where count_ > 3
